items.title: Two men re-arrested on suspicion of assisting Iran intelligence after RAF Fairford incident
items.summary: The head of UK Counter Terrorism Policing said they consider Iranian state involvement "highly likely".

items.title: Zelensky says US intelligence sharing 'works now' after talks with Trump envoy in Oslo
items.summary: Ukraine had accused the US of withholding key intelligence - a claim rejected as "scandalous" by Washington.

items.title: Government failings allowed Covid 'to spread like wildfire' in care homes, inquiry finds
items.summary: The sixth report from Covid inquiry criticises the lack of PPE and the way patients were discharged from hospital.

items.title: BBC Three, BBC Scotland and Radio 4 Extra broadcast channels to close
items.summary: The closures are announced as the corporation continues to try to save £500m over two years.

items.title: King praises Strait of Hormuz peace efforts at glittering banquet
items.summary: The Sultan of Oman, leader of a Middle Eastern strategic partner, is welcomed to Windsor for a state visit.

items.title: Elon Musk says Tesla-SpaceX merger being considered
items.summary: Musk says special committees within both companies have been formed to look a possible mega-merger.

items.title: Schools should recognise antisemitism as distinct form of harm, review says
items.summary: The government is expected to accept all 27 recommendations made in the review by ex-Ofsted boss, Sir David Bell.

items.title: Woman says she 'couldn't speak or breathe' during alleged rape by Russell Brand
items.summary: The entertainer denies three counts of rape, three charges of sexual assault and one of indecent assault.
